# FollowNet VPN

> FollowNet is a VPN app for iPhone, iPad and Mac (one universal App Store app), Android (Google Play) and a Chrome extension. Protocols: WireGuard, IKEv2, AmneziaWG, Hysteria2 and VLESS Reality, with Smart Connect choosing one that works on the current network. Free plan with a weekly traffic allowance; Premium removes the cap, unlocks all locations and covers up to 5 devices. Sign-in is passwordless (email code).

Key facts:
- iPhone and iPad: system-wide VPN through Apple Network Extension; Auto-connect, DNS profiles, Speed Test, widgets, Shortcuts.
- Mac: same App Store listing, macOS 14 Sonoma or later; system-wide VPN for every app, menu bar icon (status, connect/disconnect, server switch), kill switch, Auto-connect (Wi‑Fi only or always), DNS profiles, Speed Test.
- Chrome extension: browser-only proxy with its own Kill Switch and ad blocking; it does not protect other apps.
- Premium bought in the App Store applies to the same Apple ID on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
- Website languages: English (root), /ru, /uk, /de, /es, /fr, /pt.
